name: 給付型奨学金の選考委員会を設置
summary: 江戸川区附属機関の設置に関する条例に、給付型奨学金の給付候補者を選ぶ委員会を加えます。委員は10人以内で、委嘱または任命の日から選考が終わる日までの任期です。令和8年4月1日から施行します。
changes: 給付型奨学金の給付候補者を選考する委員会を設置する
委員の任期を委嘱または任命の日から選考完了日までとする
who: 江戸川区給付型奨学金の給付候補者
why: 給付型奨学金の給付候補者の選考について審議するためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Establishes a committee to select non-repayable scholarship candidates
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on the Establishment of Affiliated Bodies of Edogawa City
en.summary: Adds a committee to select candidates for non-repayable scholarships to the Ordinance on the Establishment of Affiliated Bodies of Edogawa City. The committee will have no more than 10 members, whose term will run from the date they are commissioned or appointed until the selection is completed. The ordinance takes effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Establishes a committee to select candidates for non-repayable scholarships
Sets members’ term from the date they are commissioned or appointed until the selection is completed
who: Candidates for Edogawa City non-repayable scholarships
en.why: The ward says the committee is needed to deliberate on the selection of candidates for non-repayable scholarships.
